Game Overview

In Doggy vs Zombie, the core idea is straightforward: guide a sprightly pup through a relentless zombie apocalypse in Doggy vs Zombie. Master timing and agility as you dodge and leap over foes. Collect items to boost your score and unleash powerful abilities, immersing yourself in an endless, thrilling run against the undead.
